sentences.en: After many hardships, he now lives in comparative ease.
sentences.zh: 经过许多艰难困苦，他现在过着相对安逸的生活。

sentences.en: I study comparative religion in the arts faculty at Turku University.
sentences.zh: 我在图尔库大学的艺术学院学习宗教比较学。

sentences.en: Yanni wrote a few books on comparative religion.
sentences.zh: 扬尼写了几本关于宗教比较的书。
